business_hours.closed_message: Please email support@example.com and our team will reply on the next working day.

intents.name: product_information
intents.response: I can help with product details, specifications, and availability. Please share the product name or SKU so I can give you the most relevant information.

intents.name: order_status
intents.response: To check an order, have your order ID ready and contact support@example.com. For privacy, do not share full payment-card details or passwords in this chat.

intents.name: shipping_delivery
intents.response: Delivery estimates and charges depend on the destination and item. Share your delivery PIN code and product name with our support team for an accurate estimate.

intents.name: returns_refunds
intents.response: For a return or exchange, keep your order ID and item details ready. Eligibility and refund timing depend on the item and its condition. Contact support@example.com to start a verified request.

intents.name: payment_methods
intents.response: Available payment methods can vary by checkout. Never send your card number, CVV, UPI PIN, or OTP in chat. If a payment was debited but the order was not created, contact support with the transaction reference only.

intents.name: account_help
intents.response: Use the 'Forgot password' option on the sign-in page. If you no longer have access to your registered email, contact support so the team can verify account ownership.

intents.name: contact_support
intents.response: You can reach the support team at support@example.com. Replace this sample address with your real business support email before publishing the project.

intents.name: feedback
intents.response: Thank you for helping us improve. Please email support@example.com with a short description of the issue and, if relevant, your order ID. Avoid including passwords or payment secrets.
